# Lark Meeting (LarkSuite)

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the real meeting-management toolkit from Lark's official CLI repo: search past meetings by time, keyword or participants, view ongoing meetings and live participants, read full transcripts and meeting minutes, generate Miaji (AI meeting notes), pull AI summaries and pending action items, send messages and reactions, manage countdown timers, capture screenshots, join meetings as a bot participant, and handle real-time voice Q&A — with strict user/bot identity management (only the authenticated user's own data is visible, cross-user access and cross-platform data leakage are prohibited). Heads-up for transparency: the SKILL.md source itself is written in Chinese — the skill content you'll install is in Chinese, which your agent needs to read to use it well. Distinct from the published larksuite-lark-workflow-meeting-summary fiche (that one is the workflow-automation wrapper that consumes meeting summaries; this one is the full interactive meeting operator). Requires the `lark-cli` CLI and a Lark/Feishu account — the platform's paid tiers apply for business use. By @larksuite, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
